notes: The signature matrix is a table. Direct-feed reads it whole; the chunked arms must land on the right rows. Turn 2 forces a discrimination between two signatures rather than a single lookup.

turns.content: DO and ORP are both crashing, EC has risen and turbidity is up. What is this?

must_contain: matches the sewage/sanitary-discharge signature: DO down strongly, ORP down strongly, EC up, turbidity up, pH down
notes the discriminator that it is not tied to time of day
states that no single parameter diagnoses an event — the combination does
must_not: names an event whose signature contradicts the given directions, such as thermal discharge or saltwater intrusion

turns.content: Could it be an algal bloom instead?

must_contain: distinguishes the bloom signature: large in-phase daily DO and pH oscillations, midday supersaturation and a pre-dawn crash
notes the described pattern is a sustained non-diel crash, which does not fit a bloom
notes the pre-dawn DO minimum is the bloom danger window
must_not: accepts algal bloom as an equally good fit without addressing the diel pattern
